say:1:1831004001:1.text: My love, <style="highlight">Zekil</style>. We agreed to meet behind the Seasong Theater under the <style="highlight">full moon</style>, but he never came.

say:2:1831004002:1.text: I've lost count of how many full moons I've spent sitting here.
say:2:1831004002:1.source_cn: 已经忘了多少个满月了，每次我都坐在这里。

say:3:1831004003:1.text: If you see that bastard, give him a warning from me: If he doesn't show up within the next hundred years, I'm done waiting.
say:3:1831004003:1.source_cn: 如果你见到他，记得帮我警告这个混蛋：下个一百年再不来，...
